name: FarmLabourPieceRateTracker
tagline: Seasonal crew kiosk, piece-rate pay and minimum-wage top-up in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete labour app for orchards, tunnels and vegetable farms: crew leaders clock workers in and out and count bins on a tablet kiosk, the app calculates piece pay, minimum-wage top-up, overtime and gross pay live, supervisors approve on a board and payroll exports a per-worker CSV.
features: Kiosk clock in/out with unit counter
Task rate table and per-entry rates
Status workflow with rules and Undo
controlType: standard (data-set) + standard (Power Pages field control FarmLabourPieceRateTrackerPortal)
